meta.question: Can ISP Group LLC sell ≥500 t/yr of Kairui phosphonates/antiscalants in Turkmenistan?
meta.coverage: oilgas.gov.tm RU tender pages 2023 (372 downloaded 11.11.2026) + 2024-2026 (798 from scratchpad); business.com.tm 213 notices (scratchpad) + 4 fetched; Comtrade mirror 2021-2025. Tender award results/prices are not published. trend.az/tenderinfo/turkmenportal searched – no additional chemical tenders beyond these portals found. Dragon Oil and Petronas publish no chemical tenders on these portals.
meta.verdict: 500 t in year 1: not achievable (base yr1 ≈40 t; market base ≈620 t).

trade_stats.method: Turkmenistan does not report to UN Comtrade (reporter 795 returned 0 records for 2021-2025). Figures are MIRROR exports to partner 795 from 18 reporters (China, Russia, Turkey, Iran, India, Germany, USA, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, UAE, Italy, Netherlands, France, UK, Korea, Belarus, Ukraine, Azerbaijan). Russia and Belarus reported only 2021; UAE and Iran stopped after 2023 – so 2024-2025 totals understate imports. HS 2827.32 queried as 282732; HS 281732 returned nothing.
trade_stats.hs_note: Correction to brief: phosphonates (ATMP, HEDP, DTPMPA, PBTCA) are non-halogenated organophosphorus derivatives = HS 2931.39 (HS2012/2017) and 2931.49 (HS2022). HS 2931.90 is "other organo-inorganic compounds" (non-phosphorus) and is NOT phosphonates. 2931.49 may also include other organo-P compounds (e.g. flame retardants), so it is an upper bound for phosphonate acids.
key_findings: China reports NO exports of 2931.39/2931.49 to Turkmenistan in 2022-2025 (only 25 t of 2931.39 in 2021). Chinese phosphonates therefore reach Turkmenistan either as formulated blends (3824.99) or via traders in Turkey/UAE/Germany.

HS 3824.99 (preparations n.e.s., incl. antiscalant/inhibitor blends but also many drilling/cement additives): mirror imports ≈7.0-7.2 kt/yr in 2024-2025 (≈$23.5-24.3M). China is #1: 3,544 t (2024) and 3,671 t ($6.52M, $1.78/kg) in 2025; Turkey 2,004 t ($9.96M) in 2025; Netherlands 484 t; Kazakhstan 254 t; Italy 187 t.
HS 3914 ion-exchange resins: very small (11 t 2023, 21 t 2024, 109 t/$1.05M 2025; Italy, Turkey, Netherlands).
HS 3811 (fuel/lube additives incl. corrosion inhibitors for mineral oils): 475-571 t in 2024-2025 (Turkey, Germany, France, China, Korea).
PAC/aluminium chloride (2827.32/2827.49): <20 t/yr – PAC is not a significant import line; coagulation relies on aluminium sulphate (see demand drivers).

demand_drivers.driver: Gas production (Galkynysh, Bagtyyarlyk/CNPC, Dowletabat, Shatlyk etc.)
facts: 2025: 76,527.1 million m3 natural gas; 8,382,300 t oil (State statistics, published 16.02.2026)
demand_drivers.chem_need: Corrosion inhibitors (mostly film-forming amine/imidazoline – not Kairui range), scale inhibitors and produced-water chemicals at gas processing plants. Evidence: CNPC CIT-26019-MR (corrosion inhibitors, 05.2026) and CIT-26033-MR (produced-water chemicals for 3 years, 07-08.2026).

estimate.label: ESTIMATE (assumptions, no published benchmark)
estimate.arithmetic: Produced water from gas fields assumed 3-8 million m3/yr (no published figure) × scale-inhibitor dose 10 g/m3 = 30-80 t/yr product; corrosion inhibitor assumed 1-3 kg per million m3 gas × 76,527 million m3 = 77-230 t/yr (non-phosphonate chemistry).

demand_drivers.driver: Oil production (Turkmennebit: Nebit-Dag/Goturdepe/Barsagelmez/Cheleken; Dragon Oil Cheleken; Eni Nebit-Dag/Burun; Khazar consortium East Cheleken)
facts: Eni pre-tender for HP water-injection pump package (06.04.2026) and water-injection project materials (14.03.2025) – waterflooding (outreach file)
Khazar: demulsifier 10 t (Заявка 292, 2025); paraffin inhibitor (Заявка 208, 2023); Turkmennebit service tender №166 for paraffin-inhibitor dosing

estimate.label: ESTIMATE
estimate.arithmetic: Water cut assumed 50-80% (base 70%) → produced water = 8.38 Mt × wc/(1-wc) = 8.4-33.5 (base 19.6) million m3/yr. Scale inhibitor 5-15 g/m3 (base 10) → 42-503 t (base 196 t) formulated product. Corrosion inhibitor 10-25 g/t total liquid (base 15 g × 28 Mt = 419 t) – mostly non-phosphonate. Demulsifier 20-50 g/t oil → 170-420 t (not Kairui range).

facts: Kiyanly/Turkmenbashy etrap desalination station 50,000 m3/day, reverse osmosis, built by Polimeks (turkmenistan.gov.tm, 09.10.2015)
Awaza national park plant 35,000 m3/day and Turkmenbashy etrap plant 50,000 m3/day – tender for technical audit to raise output (turkmenportal, 04.05.2026)
New Turkmenbashi refinery coastal pumping station + seawater desalination 15,000 m3/day: Türkmennebit with Nur Mimar, construction 06.2026–06.2029 (turkmenportal, 08.05.2026)
Khazar consortium bought RO antiscalants Culligan PF-81 200 kg + Hypersperse MDC-200 200 kg (Заявка 279, 2024)
Dashoguz water utilities tender incl. antiscalant (business.com.tm, 06.12.2025)

estimate.label: ESTIMATE
estimate.arithmetic: Permeate 85,000 m3/d (50k+35k; technology of Awaza plant not confirmed) / recovery 40% = 212,500 m3/d feed × 365 = 77.6 million m3/yr × antiscalant 1-3 g/m3 = 78-233 t/yr (base 2 g → 155 t). From 2029 +15,000 m3/d permeate → +14-41 t/yr. Brackish/municipal RO (Dashoguz etc.) +10-50 t.

facts: 12 state power stations, installed capacity 6,511.2 MW; most listed stations (Büzmeýin 246.6 MW, Ashgabat 254.2 MW, Ahal 648.1 MW, Awaza 254.2 MW, Balkanabat 380.6 MW) are GAS-TURBINE plants (minenergo.gov.tm, page saved in scratchpad 10.11.2026)
Minenergo international tender Lot №5 chemical products (business.com.tm 30.12.2025)
Mary State Power Station tested locally made aluminium sulphate coagulant (Turkmenabat chemical plant news)
demand_drivers.chem_need: Simple-cycle gas turbines need little cooling water → limited antiscalant demand; steam/combined-cycle units (Mary) need boiler-water demineralisation (ion-exchange resins) and cooling-tower inhibitors. Included in industrial cooling estimate below.

demand_drivers.driver: Refineries & gas-chemical / fertilizer plants (TKNPZ Turkmenbashi, Seydi refinery, Kiyanly polymer plant, Ahal GTL, Garabogaz urea, Mary & Tejen ammonia-urea)
facts: Kiyanly: PE 381,000 t/yr + PP 81,000 t/yr, full rates 2020 (OGJ 27.08.2020)
Garabogaz urea 1.1 Mt/yr (2018, Gap Insaat + Mitsubishi), uses ~1 bcm gas; Mary ammonia-urea 400 kt NH3 / 640 kt urea (2014) (trade.gov CCG, 20.01.2026)
Turkmengaz 2023 investment tender for Bagaja gas-chemical plant (methanol, ammonia, MDEA, DEG, TEG) – oilgas 6801

estimate.label: ESTIMATE
estimate.arithmetic: Assume ~8 large open recirculating cooling systems (2 refineries, Kiyanly, GTL, 3 fertilizer plants, Mary power) × 20,000 m3/h circulation = 160,000 m3/h; make-up ≈2% = 3,200 m3/h ≈ 28 million m3/yr; at 4 cycles of concentration blowdown = 25% of make-up; product held at 30 ppm → 7.5 g per m3 make-up → ≈210 t/yr formulated phosphonate-based cooling-water product (range 100-400 t).

facts: Domestic demand for aluminium sulphate ≈15,000 t/yr, previously all imported; Turkmenabat chemical plant restarted coagulant output (≈350 t produced from 100 t Al(OH)3), plan 120,000 t/yr (Turkmen consulate Frankfurt news, 15 March, year not shown)
demand_drivers.chem_need: Coagulant market is large but outside Kairui range (and being localised).

scenarios.definition: Addressable volume = as-supplied products of the type Kairui makes (ATMP, HEDP, PBTCA, DTPMPA, phosphonate-based scale/cooling-water inhibitors, RO antiscalants) consumed in Turkmenistan per year. All figures are ESTIMATES built from the demand-driver arithmetic, cross-checked against trade data.
scenarios.cross_check: Direct imports of phosphonate acids (2931.39/2931.49) were only 35-195 t/yr in 2021-2025 (avg ≈95 t). Formulated blends hide inside 3824.99 (≈7 kt/yr total, of which most is drilling/cement/process additives). Order of magnitude of the phosphonate segment is therefore hundreds of tonnes, not thousands.

low.assumptions: No tender win in year 1 (manufacturer-only rule, spec lock to Western brands); low water cut; small dosing.

base.assumptions: Kairui bids directly (manufacturer) with ISP as agent; wins 1-2 Lot-5 items + one CNPC/Eni/desal supply; ~6% share yr1, ~20% yr3.

high.components: RO 283 + oil scale 503 + gas 80 + cooling 400 (incl. Turkmenbashi 15k m3/d desal from 2029)
high.assumptions: Framework contract with a desal operator or CNPC 3-year produced-water package + local partner in all concerns; ~12% share yr1.

scenarios.verdict_500t_year1: NOT ACHIEVABLE. 500 t would equal ~80% of the base-case total market and ~2.6× the largest annual phosphonate import recorded (195 t, 2023). Even the high case gives ~150 t in year 1. 500 t/yr is only conceivable after 3-5 years in the high scenario, or if ISP re-exports Turkmen volumes into neighbouring markets (out of scope).

risks.detail: Turkmengaz Lot 5 "только участники, являющиеся производителями товара" since T/GAZ-20 (05.09.2025) and in all 2026 notices; Turkmennebit switched from "manufacturers + exclusive/official distributors" (2025) to manufacturers-only from №196/1 (02.06.2026). A US trader cannot bid in its own name; Kairui must bid, ISP at most agent/commission – this caps ISP volumes/margin.
Lot-5 product lists and quantities are issued only after written application and fee (500-1500 USD per lot); several buyers specify Western brands (Culligan, Hypersperse, Hercules).

Fees: Turkmengaz 500 USD/lot (1,500 USD for T/GAZ-038), Turkmennebit 575 USD, service tenders 1,725 USD; sealed envelopes delivered in Ashgabat; CNPC ITB only collected in person (passport + POA) with 7-day windows.
Velayat water utilities (Dashoguz, Mary) require registration in Turkmenistan / UIET (СППТ) membership – needs a local partner.

trade.gov CCG (20.01.2026): "Lack of manat conversion is a significant concern for repatriating profits or procuring supplies"; state concerns pay after delivery; tenders priced in USD or manat equivalent. Insist on L/C confirmed outside TM or prepayment.

China→TM rail via Khorgos–Kazakhstan: new Xining→Balkan velayat container service 5,420 km, 14-15 days (Caspian Post, 30 June, year not shown in extracted text). Alternatives: Caspian (Baku/Aktau→Turkmenbashi). Phosphonate acids are corrosive (ADR/RID class 8) – IBC/drum, winter freezing of HEDP/ATMP solutions in Kazakhstan.

Iran (trade-data only) and Russian counterparties (Tatneft branch, Russian suppliers) excluded. Avoid transit via Iran (Sarakhs) – use Kazakhstan/Caspian routes. Khazar consortium partner Mitro International uses Russian e-mail domain – verify ownership.
Turkmenistan publishes no import statistics; mirror data miss Russia (2022+), UAE and Iran (2024+). Demand estimates rely on assumed dosing and water volumes.
Government favours domestic production (e.g. aluminium sulphate restart, 120 kt/yr plan); no local phosphonate production found.
